_note: ABACUS_AGENT_CONFIG template. Copy to a private path (e.g. /tmp/abacus-agents.json) and replace EVERY placeholder below with REAL Mint identities before sending paid traffic. Each entry maps an authenticated agent to its Mint accounts + budget policy: `agent_id` (agent_...) is the X-Abacus-Agent header value the proxy authenticates; `agent_acct`/`treasury` are Mint ledger accounts (acct_...); `payee` is the provider payout address (ait1...) resolved to an account at capture time; `budget.funding_path` is `direct_hold` (reserve against `treasury`) or `allowance_ceiling` (spend against a delegated `allowance_id`). `budget.per_request_max_micros` is a local hard ceiling in µ$ (defence-in-depth atop the Mint ceiling). Extra keys prefixed `_` (like this one) are ignored by the loader.

agents._note: Placeholder direct-hold agent — for wiring/smoke tests only. Replace agent_acct/treasury/payee with real Mint identities before ANY paid traffic.

REAL-IDENTITY TEMPLATE. Fill each <...> with a value minted in your Mint server, then delete this note. This example uses the allowance_ceiling path: the reserve is a hold-backed spend against a delegated allowance ceiling (set allowance_id; treasury is still required for the account graph). For a direct-hold agent instead, set funding_path="direct_hold" and allowance_id=null. Formats: agent_id=agent_<ulid>, agent_acct/treasury=acct_<...>, payee=ait1<...>, budget_id=budget_<ulid>, allowance_id=alw_<...>, per_request_max_micros=integer µ$ (1_000_000 = $1.00).
